description: Some older SUVs are interesting because they're inexpensive. Others are interesting because they've survived with the kind of history that's becoming increasingly difficult to find. This 2005 Acura MDX Touring is firmly in the second category. With 174,506 miles, this MDX comes with a one-owner, accident-free vehicle history and local trade ownership. Finding any 20-year-old luxury SUV with one-owner history is unusual. Finding one that's also accident-free and locally owned makes this Acura worth a closer look. Finished in Billet Silver Metallic over an Ebony leather interior, the MDX has the clean, understated styling that defined Acura during this era. Its 17-inch alloy wheels and straightforward proportions have aged well, while the Touring trim gives it a surprisingly impressive level of equipment even by today's standards. Under the hood is Honda and Acura's proven naturally aspirated 3.5-liter VTEC V6 paired with a traditional 5-speed automatic transmission with overdrive and 4WD. It's classic Honda engineering from an era known for responsive naturally aspirated engines and straightforward mechanical design. The MDX was also one of the SUVs that proved a three-row family vehicle didn't have to drive like a truck. Its unibody construction gives it comfortable, car-like road manners while still providing the traction and versatility buyers want from an SUV. Inside, this Touring model reminds you just how upscale an MDX was in 2005. Leather seating, heated front seats, power-adjustable driver and passenger seats, driver's memory, a power moonroof, automatic climate control, rear air conditioning, HomeLink, rain-sensing wipers, and three-row seating provide an impressive combination of comfort and practicality. Technology was equally impressive for its era. This MDX is equipped with Acura's factory navigation system with voice recognition and a rearview camera, features that were genuinely cutting-edge when this vehicle was new. A premium Acura/Bose audio system with nine speakers and XM Satellite Radio completes the package. The third row gives you additional passenger capacity when needed, while the split-folding seating allows the cabin to transition into useful cargo space for groceries, luggage, pets, or weekend projects. But the equipment isn't the most compelling part of this particular MDX. It's the history. One owner. Accident-free vehicle history. Local trade. At 174,506 miles, nobody should mistake this for a low-mileage SUV. Instead, its appeal comes from having spent more than two decades with a single owner rather than passing through numerous hands. On an older vehicle, that kind of ownership story can be every bit as interesting as the mileage itself. Offered by Honda of Kirkland, there's also something fitting about a longtime Acura finding its way back through a dealership connected to the Honda family. If you're looking for affordable three-row transportation with genuine luxury features, naturally aspirated V6 power, 4WD, leather, heated seats, navigation, a moonroof, Bose audio, and a rearview camera, this 2005 Acura MDX Touring delivers an impressive amount of vehicle for the money. But the real headline is simpler: a one-owner, accident-free, local-trade MDX after more than 20 years. You simply don't see many ownership stories like that anymore.

2012 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 For Sale This 2012 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 is a first-year, black-on-black coupe with the 6-speed manual transmission, showing 7,200 miles from new. It comes with its original window sticker and factory build documentation from the Oshawa, Ontario assembly plant, including a handwritten note from the build team thanking the original owner and signed by members of the line crew. That paperwork confirms the car as ordered rather than pulled from dealer stock, delivered new through Greenwood's Hubbard Chevrolet in Hubbard, Ohio. Power comes from the supercharged 6.2L LSA V8, rated by Chevrolet at 580 horsepower and 556 lb-ft of torque, sent rearward through the TR6060 6-speed manual and a limited-slip differential. The dual-mode performance exhaust is factory equipment, opening up under load and staying civil at cruise. This is the combination most ZL1 buyers now specifically seek out, since a meaningful share of fifth-generation cars were built with the automatic. The chassis hardware is what separated the ZL1 from the rest of the fifth-generation lineup. Magnetic Ride Control was standard, marking its first application on a Camaro, and works alongside Performance Traction Management and Chevrolet's electric power steering setup. Brembo performance brakes sit behind 20-inch forged aluminum wheels. The car was ordered with the exposed carbon fiber weave hood insert, a $600 option offset by a factory discount of the same amount on the window sticker, so it carries the exposed weave rather than the painted insert most ZL1s wear. HID headlamps, fog lamps, heated power mirrors, and the rear spoiler round out the exterior. Inside, the black interior includes leather-appointed heated front seats with power adjustment, head-up display, the auxiliary gauge cluster with boost readout, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, premium audio with Bluetooth and USB, rear vision camera, rear parking assist, and metal pedal covers. The dealer-installed premium carpeted floor mats and cargo mat listed on the sticker were part of the original order. The ZL1 name traces back to the 1969 COPO Camaros built with the all-aluminum 427, and Chevrolet held it back until it had a car worth putting it on. For 2012 the ZL1 arrived as a coupe only, with the convertible following for 2013, making this a first-year example of the model. Between the mileage, the two-owner history, the manual transmission, and a documentation package that includes the build sheets and the plant note, this is about as complete as a preserved fifth-generation ZL1 gets. The remote programmable power liftgate opens hands-free for convenient access to the cargo area.

The premium suspension system delivers a smooth ride across various road conditions. Electronic stability control and traction control enhance stability in challenging situations, while 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power.

Exterior refinements include 22-inch bright machined wheels, body-color bumpers, and active aero shutters that optimize efficiency. Heated power mirrors with integrated turn signal indicators and auto-dimming capability reduce glare and enhance visibility. LED daytime running lamps and fully automatic headlights with delay-off function add modern styling and convenience.

This Tahoe RST stands ready to serve as a capable family hauler and daily driver. With its refined interior appointments, comprehensive safety technology, and efficient diesel power, this vehicle is prepared for your next chapter. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the comfort and capability this Tahoe offers firsthand.

The Soul LX delivers genuine value with its comprehensive Technology Package, which includes advanced driver assistance features designed to keep you confident behind the wheel. Forward collision avoidance, lane keeping assist, blind spot collision warning, and rear cross-traffic collision avoidance work together to enhance your awareness of the road ahead. Bluetooth connectivity ensures your phone stays paired, while cruise control makes highway driving more relaxing. The backup camera provides clear visibility when reversing, and a 6-speaker audio system delivers quality sound for your favorite stations.

Standard comfort and convenience features include power windows, power door mirrors, power steering, and dual front bucket seats with a split folding rear seat for flexible cargo space. Climate control keeps you comfortable year-round with air conditioning and an automatic defroster for rear windows. The remote keyless entry system and illuminated entry lights add practicality to everyday use. A telescoping, tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while the overhead console and strategically placed storage bins maximize usable space.

Built on a platform designed for real-world driving, this Soul LX includes a suite of safety technologies: dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and a low tire pressure warning system. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control provide confident braking and handling. The 2.0L four-cylinder engine with continuously variable transmission delivers an EPA-estimated 29 city and 35 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with practical performance.

We're confident this 2022 Kia Soul LX will serve you well. The rear exterior parking camera simplifies backing up and parking maneuvers, while low tire pressure warning ensures tire maintenance awareness.

The cabin incorporates quality materials and user-friendly controls, including the harman/kardon premium audio system with its 440-watt amplifier and eight-speaker configuration. Automatic temperature control with front dual zones keeps passengers comfortable, while the power moonroof adds an open-air feel. Convenience features like power windows, mirrors, and door locks, along with steering wheel mounted audio controls, allow drivers to maintain focus on the road.

With approximately 87,030 miles on the odometer, this Forester represents solid value for buyers seeking a dependable crossover SUV with a strong feature set and the reliability associated with this platform.

This 2023 Honda Pilot Touring in Gray combines capability, comfort, and reliability for families seeking a dependable three-row vehicle that handles every journey with confidence.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Leather heated seats for comfort in all seasons
- Power moonroof for natural light and ventilation
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow
- Lane Keeping Assist System active safety technology
- Blind Spot Information System warning
- Bose Premium Sound System with 12 speakers
- Rear backup camera for convenient parking
- Remote start for convenient engine activation
- Power liftgate for easy cargo access
- HomeLink garage door transmitter
- All-wheel drive for confident handling
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 90-day trial
- 20-inch alloy wheels with machine face design

The Pilot Touring stands as a practical choice for drivers who need space without compromise. With its 3.5L V6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission, this vehicle delivers capable performance combined with good fuel economy at 19 city and 25 highway mpg. The gray exterior presents a sophisticated appearance, while the non-smoker interior ensures a fresh driving environment. Available service records document the vehicle's maintenance history.

Seating flexibility defines this model's utility. With split-folding rear seats and a reclining third row, the Pilot accommodates passengers and cargo with ease. Front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory functions keep drivers and front passengers comfortable during extended drives. A front center armrest and rear seat center armrest provide convenient storage and support.

Safety and convenience features work together to enhance every drive. Electronic Stability Control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering provide confident handling in various conditions. The emergency communication system through HondaLink connects you with support when needed. Auto high-beam headlights and front fog lights improve visibility, while speed-sensitive wipers adapt to weather conditions.

Climate control zones ensure passenger comfort throughout the cabin. Automatic temperature control with front dual zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning allows individual temperature preferences. The rear window defroster clears visibility in wet or cold conditions. Heated door mirrors prevent ice and frost buildup for safer driving.

This Pilot has earned Honda True Certified status through comprehensive inspection and reconditioning. The certification includes a 182-point inspection, roadside assistance, zero-dollar warranty deductible, transferable warranty coverage, and complete vehicle history documentation. Coverage includes a 24-month/100,000-mile limited warranty from certified purchase date, an 84-month/100,000-mile powertrain limited warranty from original in-service date, and Honda Care roadside assistance for two years or 100,000 miles. Two complimentary oil changes within the first year of ownership and a SiriusXM 90-day trial are included. Two key fobs provide added convenience.

We invite you to experience this capable Pilot in our showroom and discover how its combination of space, safety, and technology serves your family's needs.

This 2021 Hyundai Santa Fe Hybrid Limited represents a thoughtful choice for drivers seeking efficiency and capability in a three-row crossover.

The hybrid powertrain delivers practical fuel economy with an EPA-estimated 33 city and 30 highway MPG, allowing you to spend more time driving and less time refueling. The all-wheel drive system provides confidence in varied weather conditions while maintaining that efficiency. This vehicle has been well-maintained and is ready for its next owner.

The interior accommodates your family with heated and ventilated front bucket seats finished in leather, memory seat functions, and a power liftgate for convenient cargo access. The dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures comfort for all passengers, while the heated steering wheel and power-adjustable driver and passenger seats add convenience to daily commutes and longer journeys alike.

Safety features work quietly in the background to help protect you and your family. Forward collision warning, lane departure warning, and lane keep assist monitor the road ahead, while the around view camera and blind spot view monitor help you navigate parking situations and lane changes with greater awareness.

Entertainment and connectivity come standard with the Harman Kardon premium audio system, SiriusXM satellite radio, and seamless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The navigation system keeps you on course, while steering wheel-mounted controls let you manage audio and cruise control without taking your hands off the wheel.

The 19-inch alloy wheels and all-weather capability make this Santa Fe Hybrid a practical daily driver that handles various conditions with composure. With its combination of efficiency, safety technology, and everyday practicality, this vehicle offers solid value in the mid-size crossover segment. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience it firsthand.

The cabin is thoughtfully appointed with an overhead console, illuminated entry, and heated door mirrors.

Safety and convenience technologies work together seamlessly in this model. The backup camera provides clear rear visibility when parking, while blind spot monitoring and lane departure warning systems alert you to potential hazards. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags provide substantial protection for you and your passengers.

The technology suite keeps you connected and informed. The Entune Premium Audio system with integrated navigation offers SiriusXM satellite radio, a CD player, and steering wheel-mounted controls for intuitive operation. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration allow you to access your smartphone's features safely, while the Wi-Fi hotspot keeps passengers connected on the road.

This Avalon Hybrid XLE Premium represents a thoughtful choice for buyers seeking reliability, efficiency, and the refinements that make daily driving more enjoyable. We invite you to schedule a test drive and see how its combination of performance and comfort suits your needs.

The completely redesigned 2021 Ford Escape drops 200 pounds and gains 2nd-row passenger space, making it best-in-class for the segment. *Driving The Used 2020 Ford Escape*

This Ford Escape comes with a 2.5-liter inline 4 cylinder engine + 88Kw electric motor that is capable of nearly 43 mpg highway.

There are five drive mode options on the Escape. Normal and Eco modes feel subdued but still dynamic, and Sport livens up the throttle response a bit. There are also modes for Slippery and Snow and Sand, even with the FWD Escape. AWD is an option for those looking for improved grip from all four corners.

The suspension on this Escape includes vibration-absorbing rear subframe mounts for a more comfortable ride. It s wider and lower than the previous gen, so it doesn t feel top-heavy, especially around corners. With 200 pounds gone, acceleration is quicker and feels nimbler. It has refined shocks, springs, and bushings and overall feels comfortable without being floaty or sloppy. The ride is surprisingly good even punching above its class.

*Interior Comfort*

The 2021 Ford Escape compact SUV gets both longer and wider affording more cargo and passenger space inside. There s enough room in the back for four bags of golf clubs. The center-stack design keeps things simple, but intuitive, with a nice balance of touchscreen and physical buttons. An 8-inch touch screen on the SE trim and above plays the starring role. Seats are comfortable and visibility is excellent. The rotary shifter is greatly improved over the previous generation s shifter, and there s now a rear center armrest.

*Exterior Styling*

For 2021 the Ford Escape sees a major redesign, so much so that it might be unrecognizable to some buyers. The front fascia imitates some European sports-crossover-SUV styling and the blue oval s own Focus. Instead of making it unique, it appears more aerodynamic but also parodies a lot of competitors. The grille drops significantly with new slanted and slightly squinty headlights extending from the top corners. The body takes on a curvier, more athletic shape to help with fuel economy, especially in the hybrid iterations. Even the roof racks are low profile to cut wind resistance. The Escape s stance got lower and wider with the compact SUV s revised dimensions.

*SECOND-ROW SLIDING SEATS*

Compact SUVs aren t known for their capacious interiors. The 2021 Ford Escape combats that issue with a sliding seat that gives 2nd-row passengers added legroom. With the recline function and supportive seat cushions, the Escape becomes a great road-trip compact SUV.

Ford s suite of safety and driver-assist features comes standard across all trims and includes post-collision braking, pre-collision assist with automatic emergency braking and lane-keeping assist.
